concept.title: Door lock/unlock features
concept.shortdesc: The vehicle is equipped with door lock/unlock features for the safety and convenience of passengers.

section.title: Impact sensing door unlock system
section.p: All doors will automatically unlock when an impact causes the air bags to deploy.

section.title: Speed sensing door lock system
section.p: All doors will automatically lock after the vehicle speed exceeds 15 km/h.

section.title: Auto lock enable on shift
section.p: All the doors will be locked automatically when the vehicle is shifted out of P (Park) while the vehicle is running.

section.title: Auto unlock on shift to P
section.p: All the doors will be unlocked automatically when the vehicle is shifted back into P (Park) while the vehicle is ON.

section.title: Auto unlock vehicle off
section.p: All the doors will be unlocked automatically when the vehicle is turned off.All doors will automatically lock after the vehicle speed exceeds 15 km/h (9 mph).

section.title: Deadlocks
section.p: Some vehicles are equipped with deadlock system. Deadlocks prevent opening of a door from either inside or outside the vehicle once the deadlocks have been activated providing an additional measure of vehicle security.
To lock the vehicle using the deadlock function, the doors must be locked by using the smart key. To unlock the vehicle, the smart key must be used again.
